_provenance.notes: Alaska ex-vessel salmon prices (price paid to harvesters at the dock) are reported monthly by species and gear type in CFEC fish ticket data. Norwegian farmed Atlantic salmon production has been the dominant driver of Alaskan salmon price volatility since the late 1990s. The 'Alaska Wild' premium brand has gradually recovered price differentials. All prices in nominal USD per pound.
